biography: Grant Thompson's journey from the sun-drenched karting tracks of rural New South Wales to the international stage has been anything but predictable. Born into a family with a deep love for motorsport, Grant spent his childhood weekends immersed in the roar of engines at local circuits. His father, a former club racer, recognized Grant's natural talent early on, nurturing his skills through years of karting competitions. A pivotal moment came at the age of 16 when Grant, against all odds, secured a wildcard entry into a Formula Ford support race at the Bathurst 1000. His aggressive overtaking maneuvers and raw speed caught the eye of Dev Star Racing, who promptly signed him to their junior program. While his raw talent is undeniable, Grant's consistency has often been his Achilles' heel. One race he's a podium contender, the next he's struggling to stay in the points. Currently, he faces immense pressure to prove his worth to Dev Star Racing and solidify his position as a future star.
drivingStyle: Thompson's driving style is characterized by aggressive late-braking and a willingness to push the car to its absolute limit. He thrives on the adrenaline of close racing, often making daring overtakes that leave spectators breathless. While his aggressive approach can yield impressive results, it also makes him prone to errors and tire degradation. He tends to over-drive the car, particularly in qualifying, searching for that extra tenth of a second, which sometimes costs him dearly in the race itself. Tire management is his biggest weakness; he struggles to maintain a consistent pace throughout a stint, often burning through his tires early on.
